contract: ../CONTRACT.md — persistent search, four existing-tool destinations, one inspector, local appearance only, readable desktop/phone/short layouts; see PHASE-1.md for scope and limits.

accessibility.evidence: Core search submits with Enter; task buttons activate by keyboard and have visible focus. Mobile task changes retain focus on a visible task button. Short-screen sheet controls pass actual elementFromPoint hit checks and 44px size checks. Error text is associated through aria-describedby and aria-invalid. Reduced-motion media is emulated for narrow/landscape captures. Field/Observatory labels were visually reviewed after contrast corrections. This is a scoped workflow review, not a full WCAG certification.

responsive.evidence: Desktop/laptop, phone, 720px zoom-equivalent and 667x375 short landscape were rendered. Search stays visible; phone has three distinct inspector sizes; scene content survives resizing; no document horizontal overflow at720px; short screen sizing controls are unobscured. Separate attribution sweep passes26 states with a representative credit line.

loading.evidence: Search owner busy-state fixture leaves stable search layout with Searching status and aria-busy; search-loading.png records the view. Real coordinate lookup completes offline in the acceptance test.

empty.evidence: Initial workspace with no selected inspector leaves the globe, search and tools usable; observatory-desktop.png. Compare unavailable guidance points to the existing imagery layer rather than claiming results.

error.evidence: Existing search owner error fixture renders inline alert and associates the field correctly; search-error.png and checks.json. No live provider failure is claimed by this fixture.

partial.evidence: All external requests were blocked. Local Natural Earth overview and its coarse-data attribution remain visible; imagery detail is not fabricated. Free-only remains active and no paid browser host is attempted.

success.evidence: Coordinate search, four destinations, scene creation/capture, saved project availability after reload and appearance persistence all pass; library-desktop.png and checks.json.

permission.reason: This phase adds no permission or authorization workflow. Existing provider setup remains subject to Phase0 Free-only enforcement, independently checked in the browser; no credentials or account resources were changed.
